content: React Flow's built-in minimap is the standard bird's-eye-view solution for large flow graphs; alternatives for orientation without a minimap include Panel (fixed overlay for breadcrumbs/controls), fitView/zoom-to-selection, search-to-node with auto-pan, and background grid for spatial reference. Large graphs (1000s of nodes) benefit from virtualization/WebGL rendering (yFiles, Cosmograph) over SVG.
